## Views (10)

| view | meaning |
|---|---|
| `by-scanner` | each scanner's normalized results side by side |
| `consensus` | reported by >= k independent scanners |
| `unique` | found by exactly one scanner |
| `disagreement` | same location, different CWE/severity across scanners |
| `by-taxonomy` | by-cwe / by-owasp / by-file / by-language rollups |
| `by-category` | sast / sca / secrets / iac / container (dynamic reserved) |
| `ranked` | ordered by finding score with explanation |
| `new-vs-baseline` | PR / diff mode |
| `taint-flows` | only findings carrying codeFlows |
| `coverage` | language / CWE x scanner matrix incl. gaps |

## Pipeline stages (11)

| # | stage | what happens |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Target | repo / dir / image under an allowed root |
| 2 | Scan | adapters run in parallel (argv-only, timeout, output cap) |
| 3 | Normalize + dedup | SARIF -> C2 findings, cwe+path+/-3 lines |
| 4 | Score + rank | noisy-OR over independent scanners |
| 5 | Views | consensus / unique / disagreement / taint-flows |
| 6 | Gate | fail_on, baseline, suppressions, require_scanners |
| 7 | Reports | sarif, html, markdown, junit, json |
| 8 | Review | deterministic checks + evidence-validated AI |
| 9 | Plan | deterministic / ai / manual strategies |
| 10 | Remediate | isolated worktree, verify, revert-on-fail |
| 11 | Pull request | dry-run default, human-confirmed publish |
